title.zh: 比较内容的关系保真：最低所需、分组与真实损失
title.en: Relational fidelity of comparison content: minimum requirements, grouping and real loss

statement.en: Regrouping keeps a frame's process and merges claims: each realization is recovered exactly where a group's members hold alike, and fidelity at both ends keeps the comparison; with requirements decided, merging is lossless on all level paths exactly when grouped formations share least requirements.
statement.zh: 重新分组保持框架的过程并合并主张：同组成员同样成立处恰能逐项恢复原实现，两端都保真时比较不变；所需可判定时，合并在所有水平路径上无损，恰当同组形成的最低所需相同。

laws.en: Regrouping a frame by a map on its claims keeps its process and realizes a group where some member is realized; at a configuration, each claim's realization is recovered from its group's exactly when, there, a group realized by one member is realized by every member.
laws.zh: 以主张上的映射重新分组一个框架，保持其过程，某成员实现处其组即实现；在一个构型上，每项主张的实现可由其组的实现恢复，恰当在那里一组只要有一个成员实现，其每个成员都实现。

laws.en: Inclusion of realized claims always passes to groups, and a newly realized group always has a newly realized member; with fidelity at the successor, inclusion of groups gives back inclusion of claims, and with fidelity at the baseline, a gain among claims shows as a gain among groups.
laws.zh: 已实现主张的包含总传给组，新实现的组总有新实现的成员；后继处保真时，组的包含给回主张的包含；基线处保真时，主张中的增益显为组中的增益。

laws.en: With fidelity at both compared configurations, extension with every claim counted (every realized claim kept and some claim gained) holds of the groups exactly when it holds of the claims.
laws.zh: 两处被比较的构型都保真时，计入每项主张的扩展（保留每项已实现主张并增加某项主张）对组成立，恰当它对主张成立。

laws.en: On a web with each requirement decided, a formation's least required level on a condition is its need where required and zero otherwise: a formation is admitted at a level profile exactly when the profile meets its least levels, and two formations have the same admission under every profile exactly when their least levels are equal.
laws.zh: 在每项所需都可判定的网上，一个形成在某条件上的最低所需水平，在需要处是其需要量，否则为零：形成在一个水平剖面上被接纳，恰当该剖面达到其最低水平；两个形成在每个剖面下接纳相同，恰当其最低水平相等。

laws.en: With each requirement decided, grouping formations step by step is faithful on every level path exactly when formations in one group have equal least required levels at every step and condition; equal requirements and needs within each group give fidelity on every level path with no decision.
laws.zh: 每项所需都可判定时，逐步分组形成在每条水平路径上保真，恰当同组形成在每一步、每个条件上的最低所需水平相等；同组内所需与需要量都相同，则不需判定即在每条水平路径上保真。

laws.en: With fidelity at two level paths, grouped extension between them is exactly widening, as extension on level paths is; equal requirements within each group give this for every two level paths.
laws.zh: 两条水平路径处都保真时，它们之间的分组扩展恰是扩大（widening），与水平路径上的扩展一样；同组所需相同则对任两条水平路径都如此。

laws.en: In the conveyor witness, the laws moving or withholding the conveyor under one inactive rest law are nonanticipating and generate from one start two courses that are feasible and balanced and follow the same rest law, their levels those of the earlier moving and withheld paths.
laws.zh: 在传送见证中，在同一不活动的其余律下搬运或扣留传送的两条律都不预支，自同一初态生成两条路线：二者都可行且平衡，并遵循同一其余律，其水平即先前搬运与扣留路径的水平。

laws.en: Merging the first and second formations, the conveyor kept apart, is not faithful on the moving path; the two generated courses are mixed, each admitting at some step a formation the other does not, while under the merged reading they realize exactly the same groups.
laws.zh: 合并第一与第二形成（传送另列）在搬运路径上不保真；两条生成的路线互相混合，各在某一步接纳对方不接纳的形成，而在合并读法下二者实现的组完全相同。

hypotheses.zh: 共享 Frame 及其已给定的主张含义；分组只改读法，不改过程。比较的扩展实例把每项主张均计入。
hypotheses.en: The shared Frame and its supplied claim interpretation; grouping changes the reading only. The extension instance counts every claim.

hypotheses.zh: 比较保真需要两处局部的同组成立一致；这是充分条件，不宣称每个偶然相同的成对排序都必须满足它。
hypotheses.en: Comparison fidelity uses within-group agreement at both compared configurations. This is sufficient, not alleged necessary for every accidentally preserved pairwise verdict.

hypotheses.zh: Web 实例沿用离散步、自然数水平与所需；最低所需的精确全水平刻画另外要求每项依存可判定。同样依存与阈值的充分形式不要求判定。
hypotheses.en: The Web instance retains discrete steps, natural levels and needs. The exact all-level minimum-profile characterization additionally takes decidable requirements; the sufficient equal-requirements form does not.

hypotheses.zh: 搬运构造使用旧 Transfer 的实际依存和给定交换；其余交换在本最小见证中不活动。
hypotheses.en: The conveyor construction uses the inherited Transfer dependencies and supplied exchange; the rest is inactive in this minimal witness.

does_not_show.en: Equal least requirements fix admission only: distinct lives, histories and expressions can have equal needs, and a many-to-one description does not make them interchangeable.
does_not_show.zh: 最低所需相同只固定接纳读法：不同生命、历史与独特表达可以同需，多对一的描述也不使它们可互换。

does_not_show.en: Admission of each formation does not give joint realizability, which must itself be among the claims if it is compared.
does_not_show.zh: 单项可接纳不推出共同可实现；若要比较，后者须自身作为主张进入框架。

does_not_show.en: Fidelity on every level path is stronger than fidelity on the feasible courses compared: the all-level test may include levels no dynamics reaches.
does_not_show.zh: 在每条水平路径上保真强于在被比较的可行路线上保真：全部水平测试可能包含动力学不可达的水平。

does_not_show.en: It does not determine actual dependencies, a unique complete content language, how changing needs are constituted, or a complete ordering of mixed gains and losses.
does_not_show.zh: 它不确定实际依存、唯一完整的内容语言、变化中的需要如何构成，或混合得失的完整排序。

does_not_show.en: No requirement that every action be lossless, and no default of institutional retreat, follows.
does_not_show.zh: 不推出一般的无损行动要求，也不推出默认的制度收缩。

detail.zh: generated_mixed_hidden 与 merged_not_respects：同一初态和其余律生成的真实相反得失，在不保真分组中消失为相同。只反驳任意分组都保留比较内容，不反驳完整关系说明。
detail.en: generated_mixed_hidden and merged_not_respects: opposed real changes generated from one start and rest-law disappear into equality under unfaithful grouping. The target is arbitrary grouping fidelity, not the full relational account.

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker: the core modules Becoming.Regrouping, Becoming.Admission, Becoming.Counterfactual, Becoming.Extension and Becoming.ValuationFrames are bound to passing receipts in becoming-checks, with an empty axiom report for every cited declaration; earlier receipts in the references checked the same statements under former names. A periphery compatibility run in correction-inquiry-checks (Lean 4.30.0-rc2 with Mathlib) also compiled the core. The author's counter-review is recorded; there is no independent review.
validation_scope.zh: 由合并的 Lean 4.29.1 检查器实查：核心模块 Becoming.Regrouping、Admission、Counterfactual、Extension 与 ValuationFrames 绑定到 becoming-checks 中通过的回执，所引声明公理报告皆空；引用中较早的回执以旧名检查同一陈述。correction-inquiry-checks 中的外围兼容运行（Lean 4.30.0-rc2 与 Mathlib）也编译了核心。作者反审已记录；无独立审查。

next_delta.en: Content beyond admission, with its correspondence, entering the comparison: joint maintenance of formations, needs that change along the course, or a warranted comparison of mixed gains and losses.
next_delta.zh: 让接纳以外的内容连同其对应进入比较：形成的共同维持、沿路线变化的需要，或对混合得失有根据的比较。

correspondence.en: Contents are read from support and exchange within one unfolding before description and comparison are tested; minimum requirements characterize admission, not separate value owners, actual identity or complete generative significance (an AI reading).
correspondence.zh: 先由共同展开中的支持、给予与取用说明内容，再检验描述和比较；最低所需刻画接纳内容，不把不同生活归约成独立价值所有者，也不等同实际身份或完整生成意义（AI 的读法）。
